compatibility.overlay: Independent environment effects. No water, foam or bubbles painted into the character.

production.method: Image generation from existing character identity and native-size extraction
production.prompt: Exactly the player character in the attached canonical sprite. Swim entirely submerged, horizontal body toward lower RIGHT in a consistent three-quarter front angle, alternating two arms and flutter kicks, raised feet and extended body. Eight frames in a wide 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet, chronological. Each frame occupies only the center 57 percent of its cell and is opaque human paint with wide empty real transparent-alpha margins throughout. Preserve same clothing, skin, face and exact proportion. No object scene, water or residue, no background, floor, lighting effect, labels or checkerboard.
production.encoding: WebP lossless, verified RGBA including fully transparent pixels

review.technical: Native detail, cell clearance and distinct WEBP phases verified
review.visual: Individual transparent poses visually reviewed for heading, silhouette and separation from VFX. Project review controls promotion.
